description:
The newest of each kind, by what names them and nothing else.

What the event stream says. A surface marks a tab from it without reading the
items, and reads [`News`] on the screen that lists them.

problems.description: The checks most recently found wrong, each with its onset.

requests.description: The numbers of the household's newest requests.

unread.description: The kinds that could not be read, as [`News::unread`] names them.

updates.description: The versions of the newest releases in the record this build carries.
